page.title: Compose
page.purpose: Submit a batch of takes from a style or a written brief, and be honest before the work starts about what it will cost, what rung it will run at, and that the result is a set to choose from rather than a track.

priorities.statement: The take count is visible and defaults above one. A caller must not be able to submit a single take by accident and conclude the model is poor.

The brief the model will actually receive is shown before submission. The caption a caller wrote and the caption that reaches the generator are the same thing unless a rewrite is explicitly requested, and if they ever differ the difference is visible.
Cost is stated before submission, not discovered during it. A ten-take batch is minutes of GPU time.
Contention is disclosed before submission. If the card is busy the batch will run at a reduced rung and take roughly three times as long; the caller should know that before waiting.
Composition being structurally unavailable — no capable GPU, or the runtime stopped — is stated plainly rather than presented as a transient error.

states.description: Ready to submit; a style or brief is selected.
The brief or parameters are rejected, with the failing field named.
The GPU is held by another tenant; the batch will run degraded or wait.
Composition cannot run at all — the runtime is stopped or no capable GPU exists.

elements.description: The named style the batch is configured with.
The caption as it will reach the generator.
How many takes the batch produces.
Estimated GPU time and storage for the batch.
The profile rung the batch will be admitted at, and why.
Why composition cannot run, and what is still available.

claims.statement: The take count is shown on the submission surface and defaults above one.
The caption that will reach the generator is visible before submission.
An estimate of GPU time and storage is shown before the batch is enqueued.
When the card is contended, the rung the batch will run at is stated before submission.
When composition cannot run, the reason and the still-available operations are named rather than shown as a bare failure.
